title: Land the token_audit standing-cost checkup: surfaces, probe, unused, checkup
objective: Answer 'what is billed on every turn regardless of use' with measurement instead of recall. Earlier audits answered this from memory and got it wrong -- notably a seven-day dead list that included six surfaces used within thirty days -- so the module pairs a two-window liveness test with a weighted share estimate.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m python_pkg.token_audit.checkup runs and prints the standing-cost report.
The whole token_audit package holds 100% branch coverage (116 tests).
Every file stays under the repo's 250-line cap.
A surface is only reported dead when unused in BOTH the short and long window, never on a single window.
pre-commit passes on all eight files with no suppression added.
out_of_scope: Acting on the report -- unregistering any MCP server, skill or rule file. This lands the instrument, not its conclusions.
The shell-coverage instrument work committed separately in 81191f40 and 29b8c5a7.
verifier: timeout 120 python3 -m python_pkg.token_audit.checkup (expects a rendered report), plus python3 -m coverage run --branch --source=python_pkg/token_audit -m pytest python_pkg/token_audit/tests (expects 116 passed and 100% with zero partial branches), plus pre-commit run --files on the eight files.
